trial_court: Principal Family Court, Chennai - H.M.O.P.Sr.No.3788 of 2020
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married on 01.11.2019. The marriage was not consummated due to the respondent's unwillingness. Petitioner sought a decree declaring the marriage null and void or divorce on grounds of non-consummation and cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: Divorce can be filed on any of the grounds stated in the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: According to the petitioner herein, it is under the provisions of Section 12(1)(c) of the Hindu Marriage Act, seeking for annulment of the marriage on the ground that there was no consummation of marriage and the provisions of Section 13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act seeking divorce on the grounds of cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: The cruelty has to be decided by the Court below.
legal_principles.held: The cruelty has to be decided by the Court below and the marriage has not been viewed to the un-consummation of the marriage.

outcome.final_order: The order passed by the trial court was set aside, and the petition was directed to be numbered and disposed of on merits.

use_for_drafting: drafting a nullity petition under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on non-consummation grounds for divorce
preparing a civil revision petition against family court order
